research.website_note: The provided website is Linear’s official site and identifies its product and customer stories.

strategy.observation: Linear offers tools to build and deploy AI agents that collaborate on tasks or handle issues end-to-end.
strategy.offer_link: Recruiting and scheduling customer interview participants could help Linear's product team investigate which tasks customers would delegate to agents and where they would want human oversight, without handling participant coordination themselves.
hypotheses: Linear's product team may be evaluating customer expectations around agent autonomy and human oversight.
The team may benefit from interviewing customers with different levels of experience using AI agents.
Recruiting and scheduling those interviews may consume time the team would rather spend conducting research.
strategy.angle: With Linear offering agents that can handle issues end-to-end, would recruiting customers to interview about delegation and human oversight be useful to your product team?
strategy.fit_reason: The offer supports customer research on a concrete product capability relevant to a Head of Product; whether Linear needs outside recruiting or scheduling support remains unconfirmed.

draft.subject: Customer interviews on oversight
draft.body:
With Linear building agents that can handle issues end to end, my guess is your product team is trying to understand where customers want autonomy vs human review.

I recruit and schedule customer interview participants for product teams, so your team can spend time on the research instead of coordination. If you're testing delegation across different user types, I can line up the right people and handle the logistics.

Would it help if I sent a simple plan for sourcing and scheduling those interviews?
